summary: Magna International filed a Form 6-K (the US/foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a routine current report) carrying its third-quarter 2026 interim results press release, quarterly report with unaudited financials and MD&A, and CEO/CFO interim certifications. Sales fell 4% to $10.1 billion on lower light-vehicle production and divestitures, while income before taxes rose 17% to $552 million and Adjusted EPS climbed 38% to $1.83. The board declared a quarterly dividend and approved a new normal course issuer bid for up to 10% of public float over 12 months. No transaction terms apply.
